title: AI-SYS-02 Human Override Rate: declared formula, numerator and denominator with honest missing-data behaviour
risk: The Human Override Rate figure is produced under different accounting rules - only full takeovers counted, so human edits and pauses disappear from the override signal - so the KPI is wrong in the direction that flatters the programme and every decision taken on it inherits the error.
preconditions: Namespace gov-kpi-<case_id>-<worker_id>; the metric is computed by the real reporting code over fixtures/offline/governance.json kpi_dataset and never copied from the dashboard payload.

Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z with the reporting window 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z .. 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z as a half-open interval; the stored aggregate is recomputed independently from the raw counter rows.
Metric scope is fixed before measurement: numerator is sessions or decisions edited, blocked, paused or taken over by a human; denominator is sessions in the window.
The dictionary entry for 'Human Override Rate' (owner, unit, window, exclusion rule) is loaded read-only and is compared with the recomputation instead of being trusted.

inputs.formula: sessions or decisions modified, blocked or taken over by a human divided by sessions in the window
inputs.wrong_value_if_buggy: only full takeovers counted, so human edits and pauses disappear from the override signal
inputs.expected_boundary_behaviour: no session in the window returns NOT_DEFINED

steps.action: Compute Human Override Rate from the frozen rows in kpi_dataset.ai_system
steps.expected: The stored aggregate reports 16.7% and records the formula, the window and the currency that produced it.

steps.action: Recompute Human Override Rate independently from the raw counter rows for the same tenant and window
steps.expected: The recomputed value equals the stored value 16.7%, and every numerator row lies inside the denominator scope.

steps.action: Force the empty-source variant of the metric (no qualifying row in the window)
steps.expected: The metric reports no session in the window returns NOT_DEFINED; the display distinguishes missing source data from a measured zero.

steps.action: Read the dashboard payload and the metric dictionary entry
steps.expected: The dashboard renders the stored value with its window, coverage and source, and the dictionary names the owner, unit, numerator and denominator that the recomputation used.

assertions: Human Override Rate equals 16.7% for the frozen window, recomputed from the raw counter rows with numerator scope 'sessions or decisions edited, blocked, paused or taken over by a human' and denominator scope 'sessions in the window'.

A recomputation that yields only full takeovers counted, so human edits and pauses disappear from the override signal is detected as wrong: the stored aggregate and the independent recomputation must agree before the figure is published.
The dashboard payload for the same tenant and window carries the stored value with its window, coverage and measurement source; it substitutes neither a design target nor another metric's value.
Boundary behaviour: no session in the window returns NOT_DEFINED; missing source data is never rendered as a measured zero.
forbidden: Counting only takeovers and dropping human edits and pauses.
Counting the same session twice for two overrides in one session.
evidence: Override audit rows with the override kind.
Session list used as the denominator.
cleanup: Delete gov- aggregate, raw-counter and scenario rows for AI-SYS-02 after exporting the recomputation table.
automation: The reporting service and the metric dictionary run as real code under test over the frozen KPI dataset; the dashboard is a consumer whose displayed value must equal the independently recomputed value. Waits are condition-based on the stored aggregate row, metric values are never supplied as inputs, and no vendor boundary is involved in the arithmetic.
